name: BSS138
title: 50 V, 0.22 A N-channel logic-level enhancement MOSFET in SOT-23

source.revision: Rev. 7, April 2024 (BSS138/D); package outline 98ASB42226B issue AU, 14 Aug 2024

summary: An N-channel enhancement-mode field effect transistor made in onsemi's high-cell-density DMOS process, rated 50 V and 0.22 A continuous, in the three-lead SOT-23. On-resistance is at most 3.5 Ω at VGS = 10 V and 6.0 Ω at VGS = 4.5 V; the gate threshold lies between 0.8 V and 1.5 V. It is aimed at low-voltage, low-current switching such as small servo motor control and gate drive for power MOSFETs.
key_figures: 3.5 Ω max at VGS = 10 V; 6.0 Ω max at VGS = 4.5 V

operation.text: The gate threshold is 0.8 V to 1.5 V at 1 mA and drifts by about -2 mV/°C. On-resistance is guaranteed at VGS = 4.5 V and 10 V; Figure 4 shows it climbing steeply as VGS falls toward 2 V.

The 0.22 A and 0.36 W ratings rest on RθJA = 350 °C/W, the device on a minimum pad (Note 1a), and dissipation derates by 2.8 mW/°C above 25 °C. RθJA is the junction-to-case resistance, fixed by the device, plus the case-to-ambient resistance, set by the board. Figures 9 to 11 give the pulsed limits.
The source-to-drain body diode carries up to 0.22 A continuously and drops 0.8 V typical (1.4 V max) at 0.44 A pulsed.
HBM class 0A and MM class M2 (Note 3). The rating covers gate to source only and implies no gate overvoltage rating.
